status: discussion-only; provisional coefficients; no game integration

assumptions.income: Exogenous, already-paid income funded by explicit income-payer cash. No endogenous demand or GDP-to-cash mechanism is demonstrated.
assumptions.values: Money amounts rounded half-up to cents; other ratios retained as Decimal.
assumptions.time: One season. Interest rates are seasonal, not annual.
assumptions.recovery: Explicit restoration of assumed income plus reduced army costs; not an automatic effect of restructuring.
assumptions.behaviour: Informality, unrest, investment conversion, credit cap, reserve, relief and desertion coefficients are illustrative.
